title: Inyana y'inzahabu yirukanwe
intro: Igitigiri kivugwa muri Korowani catumye abantu benshi bakevya mu gihe umuhanuzi w’icubahiro atariho. Ikintu cakozwe mu nzahabu cafashe imitima y’ihanga ryose — ariko inkuru y’uwo muntu irangira mu kuba wenyene no mu muvumo udasanzwe. None uwo muntu yirukanwe yoba ari nde?
clues: Naserutse mu gihe ata muhanuzi akomeye yari yaduze kugira ngo aronke ubuyobozi bw’Imana.
Nazimiye abantu benshi cane n’ikintu nahinguye n’amaboko yanje bwite.
Ico kiremwa c’inzahabu nakoze cari kimeze nk’ikifise ubuzima, kigatanga amajwi atangaza abagikurikira.
Navuga ko nabonye ivyo abandi badashobora gutahura — ukuntu mbona ibintu bitaboneka.
Narakuye ikintu mu nzira z’intumwa y’Imana maze ndagiterera mu cuma gishongeshejwe.
Naciriwe urubanza rwo kugendagenda jenyene, mfise umuvumo udasanzwe w’uko ata n’umwe yoshobora gukora ku rukoba rwanje canke ngo nkore ku rwabo.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yarateye intambwe abapfumu bo muri Egiputa

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Kuja mu bunyagano, kubuzwa gukora canke gukora ku bandi .
Bararohamye mu kiyaga bari kumwe n’ingabo .
Yaturiwe ari muzima kubera yanse ukwizera .
Yababariwe kandi aduzwa mu kibanza co hejuru .
outcome.answer: Kuja mu bunyagano, kubuzwa gukora canke gukora ku bandi .

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
